intent.proves: At least one price matrix entry is in a currency that is not the default currency.
intent.scope: all EcomPrices rows against the default currency

bindings.reason: get_prices_by_product_id reads prices per product; no whole-host price enumeration tool exists, so a host-wide count is not an equivalent observation.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomPrices p WHERE ISNULL(p.PriceCurrency, N'') <> N'' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomCurrencies c WHERE c.CurrencyCode = p.PriceCurrency AND c.CurrencyIsDefault = 1)
